WITH account_region AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
),
per_account AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, ar.region,
         AVG(CASE
               WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
               WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
             END) AS avg_signed_amount,
         AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account_region AS ar ON ar.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, ar.region
),
per_region AS (
  SELECT region,
         AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount,
         AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM per_account
  GROUP BY region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS overall_avg_signed_amount
  FROM per_region
)
SELECT p.region, p.avg_signed_amount, p.avg_balance,
       p.avg_signed_amount / o.overall_avg_signed_amount
FROM per_region AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_signed_amount IS NOT NULL
